title: Rollout-Marginal Distillation for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.37925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion enables low-latency, streamable video generation, but prediction errors often accumulate over long rollouts. Training the generator on its own rollouts exposes it to these imperfect histories. However, existing video-level distribution matching distillation (DMD) scores the whole rollout jointly. Because a chunk is evaluated together with its past and future, its correction can favor matching artifacts in the surrounding context merely to preserve temporal consistency. To provide a clearer visual-quality signal, we introduce Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD). RMD retains the generated history for AR prediction but scores each chunk independently against a chunk teacher, ensuring its quality correction is not compromised by an imperfect temporal context. To compensate for the lack of temporal context in independent chunk scoring, RMD subsequently applies video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence

translated_title: 面向长时程自回归视频生成的展开边缘蒸馏
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型能够实现低延迟、可流式传输的视频生成，但预测误差往往会在长展开过程中不断累积。让生成器在自身展开生成的结果上进行训练，可以使其接触到这些不完美的历史信息。然而，现有的视频级分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）方法是对整个展开过程进行联合评分。由于一个片段是与其过去和未来一起被评估的，其质量修正可能仅仅为了保持时间一致性而倾向于匹配周围上下文中的伪影。为了提供更清晰的视觉质量信号，我们提出了展开边缘蒸馏（RMD）。RMD 在进行自回归预测时保留已生成的历史信息，但对每个片段独立地针对片段教师模型进行评分，从而确保其质量修正不会因不完美的时间上下文而受损。为弥补独立片段评分中缺失的时间上下文，RMD 随后应用视频级 DMD 来恢复时间连贯性。
tldr: 提出展开边缘蒸馏（RMD），在保留生成历史的自回归预测下对每个视频片段独立评分以获得不受时间上下文污染的清晰视觉质量修正信号，再结合视频级分布匹配蒸馏恢复时间连贯性，从而改善长时程自回归视频生成中误差累积的问题。
en_tdlr: Rollout-Marginal Distillation (RMD) improves long-horizon autoregressive video generation by independently scoring each chunk against a chunk teacher while retaining the generated history, then applying video-level DMD to restore temporal coherence.
